pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions unless floating profit on the base tranche exceeds +$10.00 and trailing stop locks break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 3-ATR volatility expansion and order book imbalance confirmation prior to order execution to avoid wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trail stops once profit hits +$5.00 and scale out 50% at +$15.00, letting the remainder run to +$30.00.
